_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::beam_interaction#2 — a FALSIFICATION. The entry told an agent to tune SEARCH_RADIUS to 2-3 times the beam diameter for beam-to-beam contact. There is no such knob in that framework: SEARCH_RADIUS occurs exactly once in the binary's --parameters schema and it belongs to FLUID BEAM INTERACTION, declared in src/fbi/src/4C_fbi_input.cpp. Writing it into BEAM INTERACTION/BEAM TO BEAM CONTACT or into BINNING STRATEGY is rejected with 'Could not match this input' and 'The following data remains unused'. What governs the search on a beam-contact run is DOMAINBOUNDINGBOX and BIN_SIZE_LOWER_BOUND plus the segmentation angles. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: stop injecting SEARCH_RADIUS into either section. Both arms then parse and run, so the rejection diagnostics vanish and the fixture must go red.
